notes.title: Update of the demo
notes.notes:
DEMO BUILD UPDATE


I'm working hard to provide the best gaming experience possible. To achieve this, I've fixed many bugs and added new features.  


BUGS


Fixed a bug where if you dropped a bomb it would go through the ground. Fixed a visual bug where cloud speeds varied greatly between users. Fixed multiples small bugs here and there.  


CHANGES


I changed the visuals of NPC dialogues for better visibility. I changed small details in the level design to improve it.  


ADDITIONALS STUFF


I added more sounds to bring more life. I added some additional visuals in some places. You can now change the mouse sensitivity. You can now put the game in fullscreen exclusive mode or borderless fullscreen mode for people with dual monitors.  


GAME PROGRESS


I'm getting closer to the finish line :)
